items.headline: A 5.73M-SPX wallet split into 5 fresh wallets
items.detail: 2026-08-10 (11d ago). The pieces inherit the source's coin age, so it's a move, not new buying — often a holder breaking up a position to sit below the radar. Flagged unverified (same-block heuristic) — worth an eyeball.
items.framing: A whale broke a 5.73M SPX position into 5 wallets on 2026-08-10. Interesting because it's the kind of move that normally goes unseen — our clustering caught it. Say "moved/split", never "sold".
items.checkable: Same-block fan-out/fan-in in the raw transfer history; the source wallet is linked below.

items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by exchange flow
items.detail: The composite sits at the 33th percentile, but the exchange flow axis is at 85 while the rest average 41 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except exchange flow, which reads 85/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.
